summary.text: Jim Hawkins (listed on Ballotpedia as James Hawkins) is a Democratic state representative from the 2nd Bristol District who has served since April 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jim Hawkins assumed office in the Massachusetts House on April 10, 2018.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and to joint committees including Transportation and Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, and he was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
